about_the_game:
Story:

The story is set in fantasy world full of ancient magic and fantastic beasts. During attempt of reclaiming the long lost "Voidnomicon" artifact the void monsters were released into the world! You need to find all the missing pages of "Voidnomicon" and use its power to save your companions and the world from destruction.

General Description:

Fantasy mixed with anime pixel graphic Action adventure 2d platformer "Metroidvania" game.

Playable character classes:

  • Multiple playable character classes to select from: Mage, Archer, Priest and Knight

  • Different abilities and playstyle for each playable character

  • Interconnected world map locations that lets you travel back and forth.

  • Fully hand drawn art. No AI used in any part of the game.

World:

Accessible location stretch from initial cemetary, through the city into further depths of the island. Each location has its own set of unique monsters and bosses to encounter. 

Enemies

Monsters that you will encounter in the open world varies depending on their locations. Some of them are affected by void magic and others are still unchanged. There are undeads, ghosts, creatures of the night and beast monsters. 

Bosses in the game represents monsters that were affected by void magic that corrupted them from the missing pages of "Voidnomicon" book.
